title: IELTS Vocabulary: Topics
description: The words and collocations that come up again and again in IELTS: education, the environment, technology, health, work, crime and the law, cities and housing, and the media and advertising. Each unit has a short text, the words with Turkish and Arabic meanings, and practice with collocations and word forms. Written for Bo-ok.

units.title: Learning for Life
units.goal: Education: collocations such as pursue a degree, gain a qualification, drop out of.

blocks.text: Learning for Life

In many countries, compulsory education lasts for nine or ten years, but more and more people now see school as only the first stage of lifelong learning. Traditional systems are sometimes criticised for relying too heavily on rote learning, where students memorise facts for exams without really understanding them. Employers, by contrast, increasingly value critical thinking: the ability to question information, compare sources and reach a reasoned judgement.

Academic performance is not the only measure of a good school. Extracurricular activities such as sport, music and debating help students build confidence and learn to work in teams. Not every young person wants to pursue a degree, either. Vocational training allows students to gain a qualification in a practical field, such as plumbing, nursing or computer networking, often while earning a wage.

Cost also matters. Where tuition fees are high, some students drop out of university before finishing, not because they lack ability but because they cannot afford to continue. For this reason, many argue that the best education systems offer several routes, so that everyone can acquire knowledge and skills in the way that suits them best.
Words and collocations

items.example: Compulsory education ends at sixteen in many countries.
Online courses make lifelong learning easier.
Rote learning can help with times tables, but not with essays.
Debating clubs develop critical thinking.
Lack of sleep can affect academic performance.
Universities like applicants with extracurricular activities.

items.tr: üniversitede bir bölüm okumak, derece için öğrenim görmek
items.example: She moved to Ankara to pursue a degree in law.
Vocational training can lead straight to a job.
He gained a qualification in accounting at night school.
Tuition fees have risen at many universities.
He dropped out of college after a year.
Children acquire knowledge fastest through play.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Many students move abroad to ___ a degree in engineering. (one verb)

why.tr: En doğal akademik eşdizim "pursue a degree" (bir dereceyi hedefleyip okumak). Günlük dilde "do a degree" da doğrudur. "make a degree" denmez.
why.ar: التلازم الأكاديمي الأكثر شيوعًا pursue a degree، ويُقال أيضًا do a degree في اللغة اليومية. لا نقول make a degree.
why.en: The academic collocation is "pursue a degree"; "do a degree" is fine in everyday English. Not "make".

blocks.example: After working for two years, she decided to pursue a degree in medicine.

blocks.prompt: Memorising facts by repeating them, without understanding, is called ___ learning.

why.tr: "rote learning" = tekrar ederek ezberleme. "lifelong" hayat boyu, "vocational" meslekle ilgili demek; "critical learning" yaygın bir eşdizim değil.
why.ar: rote learning هو الحفظ بالتكرار دون فهم. lifelong تعني مدى الحياة، وvocational تعني مهني.
why.en: Rote learning is learning by repetition without understanding.

blocks.example: Rote learning helped him pass the test, but he forgot everything a week later.

blocks.prompt: She dropped ___ of university after her first year.

why.tr: "drop out (of something)" = okulu ya da bir kursu bitirmeden bırakmak. İsmi: a dropout.
why.ar: drop out (of something) تعني ترك الدراسة قبل إكمالها، والاسم منها dropout.
why.en: "Drop out of" means leave before finishing. The noun is "a dropout".

blocks.example: Fewer students drop out when classes are smaller.

blocks.prompt: Which verb goes with “a qualification”?

why.tr: "gain / get / obtain a qualification" doğru eşdizimlerdir. "win" yarışma ve ödül içindir (win a prize), "make" bu isimle kullanılmaz.
why.ar: التلازم الصحيح gain أو get أو obtain a qualification. أما win فللجوائز والمسابقات، وmake لا تُستخدم مع هذا الاسم.
why.en: We gain (get, obtain) a qualification; we win a prize.

blocks.example: He gained a qualification in first aid.

blocks.prompt: Good teachers help students think ___ about what they read. (critical)

why.tr: "think" bir fiil; fiili zarf niteler: think critically. Sıfat hâli isimle gelir: critical thinking.
why.ar: think فعل، ويوصف بالظرف: think critically. أما الصفة critical فتأتي مع الاسم: critical thinking.
why.en: A verb needs an adverb: think critically.

blocks.example: Try to read the news critically.

blocks.prompt: In most countries, school is ___ until the age of fifteen or sixteen. (compulsion)

why.tr: Boşlukta "is" sonrası sıfat gerekiyor: compulsion (isim) → compulsory (sıfat) = zorunlu.
why.ar: بعد is نحتاج صفة: compulsion (اسم) ← compulsory (صفة) بمعنى إلزامي.
why.en: After "is" we need an adjective: compulsory.

blocks.example: Wearing a seat belt is compulsory.

blocks.prompt: Sport, music and drama clubs outside normal lessons are ___ activities.

why.tr: "extra" (dışında) + "curricular" (müfredat) = müfredat dışı, ders dışı. "compulsory" zorunlu demek; bu etkinlikler genelde isteğe bağlı.
why.ar: extracurricular = خارج المنهج الدراسي. أما compulsory فتعني إلزامي، وهذه الأنشطة عادةً اختيارية.
why.en: Extra- (outside) + curricular (the curriculum).

blocks.example: The school offers many extracurricular activities, from chess to football.

blocks.prompt: ___ fees have risen sharply at many universities. (the money you pay for teaching)

why.tr: "tuition fees" öğretim için ödenen paradır. Kira, yemek gibi yaşam masrafları "living costs" olarak ayrıca geçer.
why.ar: tuition fees هي المال المدفوع مقابل التدريس، أما تكاليف السكن والطعام فتُسمّى living costs.
why.en: Tuition fees pay for teaching; living costs are separate.

blocks.example: Some students work part-time to pay their tuition fees.

blocks.prompt: Her academic ___ has improved since she joined the study group. (perform)

why.tr: "academic" bir sıfat; ardından isim gelir: perform (fiil) → performance (isim).
why.ar: academic صفة، ويأتي بعدها اسم: perform (فعل) ← performance (اسم).
why.en: An adjective is followed by a noun: performance.

blocks.example: Regular exercise may improve academic performance.

units.title: A Changing Planet
units.goal: The environment: collocations such as pose a threat to, take measures, raise awareness.

blocks.text: A Changing Planet

Burning fossil fuels such as coal, oil and gas releases carbon emissions, which are the main cause of climate change. To slow this process, many countries are investing in renewable energy from the sun, wind and water. At the same time, deforestation in tropical regions removes trees that store carbon and destroys the habitats of countless plants and animals. This loss of biodiversity poses a serious threat to whole ecosystems, and many endangered species could disappear if their forests are cleared.

Governments can take measures such as protecting forests, taxing pollution and supporting public transport. Individuals can also reduce their carbon footprint by flying less, wasting less food and choosing energy-efficient appliances. Campaign groups and schools play an important role in raising awareness, because people are more likely to change their habits when they understand the problem. The aim is a more sustainable way of life: one that meets our needs today without damaging the world that future generations will inherit.
Words and collocations

items.example: Most electricity was once made from fossil fuels.
The new law aims to cut carbon emissions by half.
Climate change is making heatwaves more common.
The town gets most of its power from renewable energy.
Deforestation is a major problem in parts of the Amazon.
Wetlands are rich in biodiversity.
Plastic waste poses a threat to sea life.
The snow leopard is an endangered species.
The city took measures to reduce air pollution.
Eating less meat can reduce your carbon footprint.
The campaign raised awareness of food waste.
We need more sustainable ways of farming.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Coal, oil and gas are ___ fuels.

why.tr: "fossil fuels" milyonlarca yıl önceki canlı kalıntılarından oluşan yakıtlardır: kömür, petrol, doğal gaz.
why.ar: fossil fuels أنواع وقود تكوّنت من بقايا كائنات عاشت قبل ملايين السنين: الفحم والنفط والغاز.
why.en: Fossil fuels formed from the remains of ancient living things.

blocks.example: Many countries plan to stop using fossil fuels for electricity.

blocks.prompt: Air pollution ___ a serious threat to public health.

why.tr: Sabit eşdizim: "pose a threat / a risk / a danger". "make a threat" birini tehdit etmek demektir, anlam farklı.
why.ar: التلازم الثابت pose a threat / a risk / a danger. أما make a threat فتعني أن يهدّد شخصٌ شخصًا، وهو معنى آخر.
why.en: The collocation is "pose a threat (to)".

blocks.example: Rising sea levels pose a threat to coastal cities.

blocks.prompt: Wind and solar power are forms of ___ energy.

why.tr: "renewable" = yenilenebilir, tükenmeyen. Güneş ve rüzgâr bitmez; kömür biter. "clean/green energy" de anlamca kabul edilir ama sınavda en sık geçen "renewable".
why.ar: renewable تعني متجددة لا تنفد، فالشمس والرياح لا تنتهيان بخلاف الفحم. تُقبل clean وgreen أيضًا، لكن renewable هي الأكثر استخدامًا.
why.en: Renewable energy comes from sources that do not run out.

blocks.example: The country now produces a third of its electricity from renewable energy.

blocks.prompt: The government must ___ measures to protect the forests.

why.tr: Eşdizim: "take measures / take action / take steps". Türkçedeki "önlem almak" gibi, İngilizcede de "take".
why.ar: التلازم: take measures أو take action أو take steps، تمامًا مثل "اتّخذ إجراءات".
why.en: We "take" measures, action and steps.

blocks.example: Schools have taken measures to save water.

blocks.prompt: We need a more ___ approach to farming. (sustain)

why.tr: "approach" isminden önce sıfat gerekir: sustain (fiil) → sustainable (sıfat). İsim hâli: sustainability.
why.ar: قبل الاسم approach نحتاج صفة: sustain (فعل) ← sustainable (صفة). والاسم sustainability.
why.en: Before a noun we need an adjective: sustainable.

blocks.example: The hotel is trying to become more sustainable.

blocks.prompt: The tiger is an ___ species. (danger)

why.tr: "endangered" = tehlike altına sokulmuş, nesli tükenmekte. "dangerous" ise tehlikeli demek; kaplan tehlikeli olabilir ama burada anlatılan neslinin tükenmesi.
why.ar: endangered تعني مهدّدًا بالانقراض، أما dangerous فتعني خطيرًا. النمر قد يكون خطيرًا، لكن المقصود هنا أنه مهدّد.
why.en: Endangered means at risk of dying out; dangerous means able to hurt you.

blocks.example: Many endangered species live only in rainforests.

blocks.prompt: The campaign aims to raise ___ of plastic pollution.

why.tr: "raise awareness of / about something" = bir konuda farkındalık yaratmak. "aware" sıfat, "awareness" isimdir.
why.ar: raise awareness of/about تعني رفع الوعي بقضية. aware صفة، وawareness اسم.
why.en: "Raise awareness of" something; awareness is the noun of aware.

blocks.example: The film raised awareness of the dangers of smoking.

blocks.prompt: The cutting down of forests on a large scale is called ___.

why.tr: "de-" öneki kaldırmayı, yok etmeyi gösterir: de + forest + ation = ormanların yok edilmesi. "biodiversity" canlı çeşitliliğidir.
why.ar: البادئة de- تدل على الإزالة: de + forest + ation = إزالة الغابات. أما biodiversity فهي تنوّع الكائنات الحية.
why.en: De- means removing: deforestation is removing forests.

blocks.example: Deforestation leaves the soil exposed to heavy rain.

blocks.prompt: Cycling to work is one way to reduce your carbon ___.

why.tr: "carbon footprint" bir kişinin ya da şirketin neden olduğu toplam karbon salımıdır. "reduce / cut your carbon footprint".
why.ar: carbon footprint هي مجموع انبعاثات الكربون التي يسببها شخص أو شركة. نقول reduce أو cut your carbon footprint.
why.en: Your carbon footprint is the total carbon your activities produce.

blocks.example: Buying local food can reduce your carbon footprint.

units.title: Living Online
units.goal: Technology: collocations such as rely heavily on, become obsolete, automate tasks.

blocks.text: Living Online

Technological advances have changed the way we work, study and communicate. Many offices now use software to automate tasks that once took hours, and artificial intelligence can translate texts, recognise faces and suggest what we might want to buy. As a result, some jobs are likely to become obsolete, while new ones appear in areas that did not exist twenty years ago.

These benefits come with concerns. Many people rely heavily on their phones, and some worry that they are becoming addicted to social media. Parents often try to limit their children's screen time, and schools increasingly teach digital literacy: the ability to find, judge and use information online safely. Cyberbullying, in which young people are insulted or threatened through messages and posts, is another problem schools have to deal with. Data privacy is also a growing issue, since companies collect large amounts of information about what users do online.
Even so, few people would choose to give up cutting-edge devices altogether. The challenge is to design technology that is user-friendly and safe, and to teach people to use it wisely.
Words and collocations

items.example: Technological advances have made solar panels cheaper.
The bank automated many tasks that clerks once did.
Artificial intelligence is used to detect fraud.
Fax machines have almost become obsolete.
Farmers rely heavily on the weather.
He admits he is addicted to his phone.
Doctors advise limiting screen time before bed.
Digital literacy is now taught in primary schools.
The school has a clear policy on cyberbullying.
Many users worry about data privacy.
The hospital uses cutting-edge equipment.
The new app is very user-friendly.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Many people rely ___ on their smartphones.

why.tr: Eşdizim: "rely heavily on" = büyük ölçüde dayanmak. Dikkat: "hardly" "hard" demek değil, "neredeyse hiç" demektir; anlamı tersine çevirir.
why.ar: التلازم rely heavily on بمعنى يعتمد بشدّة. انتبه: hardly لا تعني "بشدة" بل "بالكاد"، فتعكس المعنى.
why.en: "Rely heavily on" is the collocation. "Hardly" means almost not.

blocks.example: The region relies heavily on tourism.

blocks.prompt: Typewriters have become ___ — almost nobody uses them now.

why.tr: "become obsolete" = artık kullanılmaz olmak (yerini daha yeni bir şey aldığı için). "outdated" da anlamca yakın.
why.ar: become obsolete تعني أن الشيء لم يعد يُستخدم لأن شيئًا أحدث حلّ محله. وoutdated قريبة في المعنى.
why.en: Obsolete means no longer used because something newer has replaced it.

blocks.example: Many skills become obsolete as technology changes.

blocks.prompt: The app is very ___ — even my grandmother can use it. (user / friend)

why.tr: Birleşik sıfat: user + friendly = kullanıcı dostu. İsimden önce genellikle tire ile yazılır: a user-friendly app.
why.ar: صفة مركّبة: user + friendly = سهل الاستخدام، وتُكتب عادةً بشرطة قبل الاسم: a user-friendly app.
why.en: Compound adjective: user-friendly.

blocks.example: The website is clear and user-friendly.

blocks.prompt: Software can ___ many repetitive tasks.

why.tr: "can" sonrası yalın fiil gelir: automate. "automatic" sıfat, "automation" isim, "automatically" zarf.
why.ar: بعد can يأتي الفعل المجرد: automate. أما automatic فصفة، وautomation اسم، وautomatically ظرف.
why.en: After "can" we need a base verb: automate.

blocks.example: Many factories have automated their production lines.

blocks.prompt: He is addicted ___ video games.

why.tr: "addicted TO something". Burada "to" bir edattır, bu yüzden ardından isim ya da -ing gelir: addicted to playing.
why.ar: نقول addicted TO something، وto هنا حرف جر، فيأتي بعدها اسم أو فعل بـ -ing: addicted to playing.
why.en: "Addicted to" + noun or -ing.

blocks.example: She was addicted to sugar for years.

blocks.prompt: Schools should teach digital ___ from an early age. (literate)

why.tr: "digital" sıfatından sonra isim gerekir: literate (sıfat) → literacy (isim) = okuryazarlık.
why.ar: بعد الصفة digital نحتاج اسمًا: literate (صفة) ← literacy (اسم) بمعنى محو الأمية أو الثقافة.
why.en: After an adjective we need a noun: literacy.

blocks.example: Media literacy helps students spot false news.

blocks.prompt: Which word means “the newest and most advanced”?

why.tr: "cutting-edge" = son teknoloji, alanında en ileri. "out-of-date" tam tersi (eski), "second-hand" ikinci el.
why.ar: cutting-edge تعني الأحدث والأكثر تقدمًا. out-of-date عكسها (قديم)، وsecond-hand مستعمل.
why.en: Cutting-edge means the most advanced; out-of-date is the opposite.

blocks.example: The lab does cutting-edge research on batteries.

blocks.prompt: Doctors recommend limiting children's screen ___.

why.tr: "screen time" = telefon, tablet, TV gibi ekranlara bakılarak geçirilen süre.
why.ar: screen time هو الوقت الذي يُقضى أمام الشاشات: الهاتف والجهاز اللوحي والتلفاز.
why.en: Screen time is time spent looking at screens.

blocks.example: We have a rule: no screen time at dinner.

blocks.prompt: There have been huge ___ in medical technology. (advance)

why.tr: "huge" sıfatından sonra isim gerekir; "there have been" çoğul olduğu için çoğul isim: advances.
why.ar: بعد الصفة huge نحتاج اسمًا، ولأن there have been للجمع نقول advances.
why.en: "There have been" is plural, so: advances.

blocks.example: Recent advances in medicine have saved many lives.

units.title: Staying Healthy in a Busy World
units.goal: Health: collocations such as a balanced diet, a sedentary lifestyle, be prone to.

blocks.text: Staying Healthy in a Busy World

Life expectancy has risen in most parts of the world over the last century, thanks to better nutrition, clean water, vaccines and modern healthcare systems. Yet many people now face a different set of health problems. Office work, long commutes and evenings in front of a screen have led to a more sedentary lifestyle, which is linked to obesity and to chronic illnesses such as type 2 diabetes and heart disease.

Doctors generally agree on the basics: eat a balanced diet with plenty of vegetables, take regular exercise and get enough sleep. People who sleep badly over long periods tend to be more prone to illness and find it harder to concentrate. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, and a healthy work-life balance can reduce stress.

Many experts argue that governments should spend more on prevention, for example by making it easier to walk or cycle and by teaching children to cook simple, healthy meals. As the saying goes, prevention is better than cure: it is usually cheaper, and far less painful, to avoid an illness than to treat it.
Words and collocations

items.example: Life expectancy in Japan is among the highest in the world.
The healthcare system is under pressure in winter.
A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
Obesity rates have risen in many countries.
Asthma is a chronic illness that can be controlled.
A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables and protein.
Try to take regular exercise, even just walking.
Teenagers often do not get enough sleep.
Older people are more prone to falls.
Talking to friends is good for your mental health.
Flexible hours can improve work-life balance.
Get the car checked now — prevention is better than cure.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Doctors advise people to ___ regular exercise.

why.tr: Eşdizim: "take exercise" (İngiliz İngilizcesi) ya da "get / do exercise". "make exercise" yanlıştır; Türkçedeki "yapmak"ı "make" diye çevirme.
why.ar: التلازم take exercise (أو get/do exercise). لا نقول make exercise، فلا تترجم "يمارس" إلى make.
why.en: We take (or get, do) exercise — never "make exercise".

blocks.example: She takes regular exercise and rarely gets ill.

blocks.prompt: A ___ diet includes fruit, vegetables, grains and protein.

why.tr: "a balanced diet" = her besin grubundan doğru miktarda içeren beslenme. "diet" burada "rejim" değil, genel beslenme düzeni demek.
why.ar: a balanced diet نظام غذائي يضم كل المجموعات بكميات مناسبة. وdiet هنا لا تعني الحمية بل طريقة الأكل عمومًا.
why.en: A balanced diet has the right amounts of each food group.

blocks.example: Children need a balanced diet to grow well.

blocks.prompt: Someone who sits for most of the day has a ___ lifestyle.

why.tr: "sedentary" = oturarak geçen, hareketsiz. "active" tam tersi. "chronic" hastalıklar için kullanılır, yaşam tarzı için değil.
why.ar: sedentary تعني قليل الحركة وكثير الجلوس، وactive عكسها. أما chronic فتُستخدم للأمراض لا لنمط الحياة.
why.en: Sedentary means spending most of the time sitting.

blocks.example: Office workers often have a sedentary lifestyle.

blocks.prompt: Childhood ___ is increasing in some countries. (obese)

why.tr: Cümlenin öznesi isim olmalı: obese (sıfat) → obesity (isim). "Childhood obesity" yaygın bir eşdizimdir.
why.ar: الفاعل يجب أن يكون اسمًا: obese (صفة) ← obesity (اسم). وchildhood obesity تعبير شائع.
why.en: The subject needs a noun: obesity.

blocks.example: Schools are trying to tackle childhood obesity.

blocks.prompt: Older people are more ___ to falls.

why.tr: "be prone to something" = bir şeye yatkın olmak, kolayca başına gelmek. Genelde kötü şeyler için: prone to illness, prone to injury.
why.ar: be prone to something تعني أن يكون عُرضةً لشيء، وغالبًا لأمور سيئة: prone to illness وprone to injury.
why.en: "Be prone to" means likely to suffer from something.

blocks.example: This area is prone to flooding.

blocks.prompt: A chronic illness is one that

why.tr: "chronic" = uzun süren, süreğen. Zıddı "acute" (aniden başlayan, kısa süren). Şeker hastalığı kronik; grip akut.
why.ar: chronic تعني مزمن يستمر طويلًا، وعكسها acute أي حادّ يبدأ فجأة ولا يطول. السكري مزمن، والإنفلونزا حادّة.
why.en: Chronic means long-lasting; the opposite is acute.

blocks.example: Diabetes is a chronic illness; flu is an acute one.

blocks.prompt: Life ___ is higher in Japan than in many other countries. (expect)

why.tr: Sabit ifade: "life expectancy" (ortalama yaşam süresi). "expectation" beklenti demektir, burada kullanılmaz.
why.ar: التعبير الثابت life expectancy أي متوسط العمر المتوقع. أما expectation فتعني التوقّع أو الأمل، ولا تُستخدم هنا.
why.en: The fixed phrase is "life expectancy", not "life expectation".

blocks.example: Life expectancy has risen thanks to better healthcare.

blocks.prompt: Try to get ___ sleep before the exam.

why.tr: "get enough sleep" = yeterince uyumak. "enough" isimden önce gelir (enough sleep), sıfattan sonra gelir (old enough).
why.ar: get enough sleep تعني النوم بما يكفي. تأتي enough قبل الاسم (enough sleep) وبعد الصفة (old enough).
why.en: "Enough" goes before a noun: enough sleep.

blocks.example: Most adults need seven or more hours to get enough sleep.

blocks.prompt: Which saying means it is better to stop a problem before it starts?

why.tr: "Prevention is better than cure" = önlem tedaviden iyidir. "No pain, no gain" emeksiz yemek olmaz; "Better late than never" geç olsun güç olmasın demektir.
why.ar: "Prevention is better than cure" تعني الوقاية خير من العلاج. أما "No pain, no gain" فتعني لا نجاح بلا تعب، و"Better late than never" أن تأتي متأخرًا خير من ألّا تأتي.
why.en: "Prevention is better than cure" — avoid the problem instead of fixing it later.

blocks.example: Wash your hands often: prevention is better than cure.

units.title: The Changing World of Work
units.goal: Work: collocations such as apply for a job, job satisfaction, work long hours, be made redundant.

blocks.text: The Changing World of Work

For earlier generations, the ideal was often a job for life: you joined a company after school or university, climbed the career ladder step by step and retired from the same employer. Today, far fewer people expect this. Many will apply for jobs in several different fields during their working lives, and some will be made redundant when a company closes or replaces workers with machines.

Pay is not the only thing people look for. Surveys of workers regularly suggest that job satisfaction depends just as much on feeling useful, learning new skills and getting on well with colleagues. Job security matters too, especially for people with families or a mortgage. At the same time, more employees now value flexible working hours, or the chance to work from home for part of the week.

Not all change is positive. In some industries, people work long hours for a low income, and short-term contracts make it hard to plan for the future. Others choose to become self-employed so that they can control their own time, though this usually means giving up benefits such as paid holidays. Whatever path people follow, the ability to keep learning is likely to be one of the most valuable skills of all.
Words and collocations

items.example: My grandfather had a job for life at the railway.
She climbed the career ladder quickly and became a manager at thirty.
He applied for a job at the local hospital.
Two hundred workers were made redundant when the factory closed.
Teachers often report high job satisfaction but low pay.
A permanent contract gives you more job security.
Flexible working hours help parents with young children.
Many office staff now work from home two days a week.
Junior doctors often work long hours.
Families on a low income may receive help with rent.
As a self-employed designer, she chooses her own clients.
It is easier to enjoy work if you get on well with colleagues.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: She ___ for a job as a nurse at the city hospital.

why.tr: Kalıp: "apply for a job" (bir işe başvurmak). "ask for a job" günlük dilde var ama resmî başvuruyu anlatmaz; "request" ve "join" "for" ile bu anlamda kullanılmaz.
why.ar: التلازم الصحيح apply for a job أي تقدّم لوظيفة. ask for a job لا يعني تقديم طلب رسمي، وrequest وjoin لا تُستخدمان مع for بهذا المعنى.
why.en: The collocation is "apply for a job".

blocks.example: Over a hundred people applied for the job.

blocks.prompt: When the factory closed, all the workers were made ___. (one word)

why.tr: "be made redundant" = kadro fazlası olduğu için işten çıkarılmak (kişinin hatası yüzünden değil). Kişinin hatası yüzünden ise "be dismissed / be fired" denir.
why.ar: be made redundant تعني التسريح لأن الوظيفة لم تعد مطلوبة، لا بسبب خطأ الموظف. أما الفصل بسبب خطأ فهو be dismissed أو be fired.
why.en: "Be made redundant" = lose your job because it is no longer needed, not because of a mistake.

blocks.example: He was made redundant after twenty years with the bank.

blocks.prompt: A permanent contract gives you more job ___: you are less likely to lose your job.

why.tr: "job security" = işini kaybetmeme güvencesi. "safety" fiziksel güvenliktir (work safety: iş güvenliği, kaza riski). "secure" ve "safe" sıfattır; isim gerekir.
why.ar: job security تعني الأمان من فقدان الوظيفة. أما safety فهي السلامة الجسدية (مثل الحوادث). وsecure وsafe صفتان، والمطلوب اسم.
why.en: Job security = not losing your job; safety is physical. A noun is needed.

blocks.example: Many young workers worry about job security.

blocks.prompt: People who work for themselves rather than for a company are ___-employed.

why.tr: "self-employed" = kendi hesabına çalışan. Zıddı "employed by a company" ya da "an employee". Tire ile yazılır.
why.ar: self-employed تعني من يعمل لحسابه الخاص، وتُكتب بشرطة. عكسها موظف لدى شركة (an employee).
why.en: "Self-employed" = working for yourself.

blocks.example: Many taxi drivers are self-employed.

blocks.prompt: After years of hard work, he finally ___ the career ladder to become director.

why.tr: Eşdizim: "climb the career ladder" (merdiven gibi düşün: basamak basamak çıkılır). "rise" geçişsizdir, nesne almaz: "rose to director" denir ama "rose the ladder" denmez.
why.ar: التلازم climb the career ladder، كصعود سلّم درجةً درجة. أما rise فلازم لا يأخذ مفعولًا: نقول rose to director لا rose the ladder.
why.en: We "climb" a ladder; "rise" takes no object.

blocks.example: It took her ten years to climb the career ladder.

blocks.prompt: Nurses often work ___ hours, including nights and weekends. (one word)

why.tr: "work long hours" = uzun saatler çalışmak. "many hours" da anlaşılır ama doğal eşdizim "long hours". "much hours" yanlıştır: "hours" sayılabilir.
why.ar: التلازم الطبيعي work long hours. قد تُفهم many hours لكنها أقل طبيعية، وmuch hours خطأ لأن hours معدودة.
why.en: The natural collocation is "work long hours".

blocks.example: Restaurant staff often work long hours at weekends.

blocks.prompt: I enjoy my job mainly because I get ___ well with my colleagues.

why.tr: Deyimsel fiil: "get on well with someone" (İngiliz İngilizcesi) = biriyle iyi geçinmek. Amerikan İngilizcesinde "get along with" da denir, ama "along to" yanlış.
why.ar: الفعل المركّب get on well with someone يعني يتفاهم مع شخص (إنجليزية بريطانية)، ويُقال أيضًا get along with، أما along to فخطأ.
why.en: "Get on (well) with someone" = have a good relationship.

blocks.example: She gets on well with everyone in the office.

blocks.prompt: Many parents look for ___ working hours so they can collect their children from school. (one word)

why.tr: "flexible working hours" = esnek çalışma saatleri, yani saatleri kişi kendisi biraz ayarlayabilir. Zıddı "fixed hours".
why.ar: flexible working hours أي ساعات عمل مرنة يمكن تعديلها، وعكسها fixed hours.
why.en: "Flexible" hours can be changed to suit the worker.

blocks.example: The company offers flexible working hours to all staff.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: She has a low income, so she rents a small flat.
She has a little income, so she rents a small flat.
She has a short income, so she rents a small flat.
She has a cheap income, so she rents a small flat.

why.tr: Gelir için "high / low income" denir. "cheap" fiyat için kullanılır (cheap flat), gelir için değil. "short" süre ya da boy içindir.
why.ar: مع الدخل نقول high/low income. أما cheap فللأسعار (cheap flat)، وshort للمدة أو الطول.
why.en: Income is high or low, never cheap or short.

blocks.example: Students often live on a low income.

units.title: Crime and the Law
units.goal: Crime and law: collocations such as commit a crime, serve a sentence, a deterrent, reoffend.

blocks.text: Crime and the Law

Every society has to decide how to respond when people break the law. When someone commits a crime, the police investigate, and if there is enough evidence, the suspect is charged and taken to court. If the court finds the person guilty, a judge decides on the punishment, which may be a fine, community service or a prison sentence.

People disagree about what punishment is for. Some believe its main purpose is to act as a deterrent, so that the fear of prison stops others from doing the same thing. Others argue that the aim should be rehabilitation, helping offenders to change so that they can return to normal life. Many studies of prison systems have found that people who receive education or job training while they serve their sentence are less likely to reoffend after release.

Prevention matters too. Better street lighting, more youth clubs and help for families in difficulty can all reduce the crime rate, particularly among young people. Most experts agree that a fair justice system needs both: firm action against serious crime and real efforts to tackle the causes of crime before it happens.
Words and collocations

items.example: Driving without a licence is breaking the law.
Most people who commit a crime are young men.
The police found new evidence at the scene.
He was charged with theft.
The jury found her guilty of fraud.
He was given 100 hours of community service.
She received a two-year prison sentence.
He served his sentence in a prison near the coast.
Heavy fines act as a deterrent to dangerous drivers.
The prison focuses on rehabilitation through education.
Young people who find work are less likely to reoffend.
The crime rate in the city fell last year.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Anyone who ___ a crime should face the consequences.

why.tr: Eşdizim: "commit a crime" (suç işlemek). Türkçedeki "işlemek/yapmak" fiilini "make" ya da "do" diye çevirme; "commit" aynı zamanda "commit murder, commit fraud" için de kullanılır.
why.ar: التلازم commit a crime أي يرتكب جريمة. لا تترجم "يرتكب" إلى make أو do. ونقول أيضًا commit murder وcommit fraud.
why.en: We "commit" a crime (also commit murder, commit fraud).

blocks.example: He was arrested before he could commit another crime.

blocks.prompt: The man was ___ with burglary after his fingerprints were found. (one word)

why.tr: "be charged with + suç" = resmî olarak suçlanmak. Edata dikkat: "with". "accused of" da benzer anlamda ama "of" ile kullanılır.
why.ar: be charged with + الجريمة تعني يُتّهم رسميًا. انتبه لحرف الجر with، أما accused فتأتي مع of.
why.en: "Be charged with" a crime = be officially accused (note: with; but accused of).

blocks.example: She was charged with dangerous driving.

blocks.prompt: The jury ___ him guilty of all three crimes.

why.tr: Kalıp: "find someone guilty / not guilty (of)". Mahkemenin kararı için "find" kullanılır; "make him guilty" denmez.
why.ar: التركيب find someone guilty (of) أي حكم بإدانته. لقرار المحكمة نستخدم find، ولا نقول make him guilty.
why.en: Courts "find" someone guilty (of a crime).

blocks.example: The court found the company guilty of polluting the river.

blocks.prompt: Some people think longer prison sentences act as a ___ to other criminals. (one word)

why.tr: "a deterrent" = caydırıcı (insanları bir şeyi yapmaktan vazgeçiren şey). Fiili "deter": Cameras deter thieves. "act as a deterrent" yaygın bir kalıptır.
why.ar: a deterrent تعني رادعًا يمنع الناس من فعل شيء، والفعل deter. والعبارة act as a deterrent شائعة.
why.en: A deterrent stops people from doing something; the verb is "deter".

blocks.example: Security cameras can be a deterrent to shoplifters.

blocks.prompt: Helping prisoners learn skills so that they can live normally after release is called

why.tr: "rehabilitation" = suçluyu topluma yeniden kazandırma. "punishment" ceza, "deterrence" caydırma (başkalarını korkutma), "evidence" kanıttır.
why.ar: rehabilitation تعني إعادة تأهيل السجين ليعود إلى الحياة الطبيعية. أما punishment فعقوبة، وdeterrence ردع، وevidence دليل.
why.en: Rehabilitation helps offenders change; deterrence frightens others.

blocks.example: Education in prison is an important part of rehabilitation.

blocks.prompt: He ___ his sentence and was released after three years. (past tense)

why.tr: "serve a sentence" = cezasını çekmek. Geçmiş zaman: served. "did his sentence" konuşmada duyulur ama akademik yazıda "served" kullan.
why.ar: serve a sentence تعني يقضي مدة العقوبة، والماضي served. قد تُسمع did his sentence في الكلام، لكن في الكتابة الأكاديمية استخدم served.
why.en: "Serve a sentence"; past: served.

blocks.example: She served her sentence and now works with young offenders.

blocks.prompt: Former prisoners who find a job are less likely to ___.

why.tr: "reoffend" = tekrar suç işlemek (re- = yeniden). "rehabilitate" birine yapılan bir şeydir (topluma kazandırmak); "deter" ve "sentence" nesne ister ve anlam uymaz.
why.ar: reoffend تعني يعود إلى الجريمة (re- = مرة أخرى). أما rehabilitate فهو ما نفعله لشخص، وdeter وsentence تحتاجان مفعولًا ولا يناسب معناهما.
why.en: Reoffend = commit a crime again.

blocks.example: Education reduces the chance that prisoners will reoffend.

blocks.prompt: Better street lighting helped to lower the crime ___ in the area. (one word)

why.tr: "the crime rate" = suç oranı (belli bir nüfusta ne kadar suç işlendiği). Aynı yapı: birth rate, unemployment rate.
why.ar: the crime rate تعني معدل الجريمة. ومثلها birth rate وunemployment rate.
why.en: "The crime rate" = how much crime happens; compare unemployment rate.

blocks.example: The crime rate has fallen for five years in a row.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: There is not enough evidences to take him to court.
There is not enough evidence to take him to court.
There are not enough evidence to take him to court.
There is not enough an evidence to take him to court.

why.tr: "evidence" sayılamayan bir isimdir: -s almaz, "an" almaz ve tekil fiille kullanılır (there is). Tek bir kanıt için "a piece of evidence" de.
why.ar: evidence اسم غير معدود: لا يُجمع بـ -s ولا يأتي مع an، ويأخذ فعلًا مفردًا (there is). لدليل واحد قل a piece of evidence.
why.en: "Evidence" is uncountable: no -s, no "an", singular verb. Say "a piece of evidence".

blocks.example: The police found an important piece of evidence.

units.title: Cities and Housing
units.goal: Cities and housing: collocations such as affordable housing, a densely populated area, urban sprawl, public transport.

blocks.text: Where Will Everyone Live?

More than half of the world's population now lives in towns and cities, and the share continues to grow. Young people in particular move to cities in search of work and education. As a result, many urban areas face a housing shortage: there are simply not enough homes for everyone who wants to live there, and rents and house prices rise faster than wages.

Governments respond in different ways. Some build more affordable housing, homes that people on ordinary incomes can rent or buy. Others encourage developers to build on brownfield sites, land that was used before, for example by old factories, so that green fields at the edge of the city are protected. If cities simply spread outwards, the result is urban sprawl: long distances, heavy traffic and the loss of countryside.

Building upwards is another option. A densely populated area can support good public transport, local shops and services within walking distance. However, high-rise buildings must be well designed and well maintained, with green space nearby, or they can become unpleasant places to live. Most planners agree that a good city is not only about the number of homes, but also about the quality of the neighbourhood around them.
Words and collocations

items.example: Most jobs are found in urban areas.
The city has a serious housing shortage.
The council plans to build 500 units of affordable housing.
Rents and house prices have doubled in ten years.
The new homes were built on a brownfield site near the station.
Urban sprawl has swallowed many villages.
Hong Kong is one of the most densely populated places on earth.
Good public transport reduces traffic.
The school is within walking distance of our flat.
The old high-rise buildings were replaced with smaller blocks.
Children need green space to play.
It is a quiet neighbourhood with a good park.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Many young families cannot find ___ housing near the city centre. (one word)

why.tr: "affordable housing" = orta ve düşük gelirlilerin karşılayabileceği konut. Fiil "afford" (gücü yetmek) → sıfat "affordable". "cheap housing" da olur ama olumsuz (kalitesiz) bir çağrışım taşıyabilir.
why.ar: affordable housing مساكن يستطيع أصحاب الدخل العادي تحمّل كلفتها. الفعل afford ← الصفة affordable. أما cheap housing فقد توحي بالجودة الرديئة.
why.en: afford → affordable: homes people on ordinary incomes can pay for.

blocks.example: The government promised more affordable housing for nurses and teachers.

blocks.prompt: When a city spreads outwards over the countryside without much planning, this is called urban

why.tr: "urban sprawl" sabit bir ifadedir: şehrin plansızca ve dağınık biçimde kırsala yayılması. "density" (yoğunluk) bunun tam tersine yakındır.
why.ar: urban sprawl تعبير ثابت يعني الزحف العمراني غير المنظّم نحو الريف. أما density (الكثافة) فقريبة من عكسه.
why.en: "Urban sprawl" is the fixed phrase; density is almost the opposite.

blocks.example: Urban sprawl means longer journeys to work.

blocks.prompt: Hong Kong is one of the most ___ populated cities in the world.

why.tr: "populated" bir sıfat (geçmiş ortaç); onu bir zarf niteler: densely populated. "dense" sıfattır: a dense population. "crowdedly" İngilizcede kullanılmaz.
why.ar: populated صفة (اسم مفعول) يصفها ظرف: densely populated. أما dense فصفة: a dense population. وcrowdedly غير مستعملة.
why.en: An adverb before "populated": densely populated (but: a dense population).

blocks.example: Densely populated areas need good public transport.

blocks.prompt: The supermarket is within ___ distance, so we don't need a car. (one word)

why.tr: Kalıp: "within walking distance (of)" = yürüyerek gidilebilecek kadar yakın. "walk distance" yanlıştır; -ing gerekir.
why.ar: التركيب within walking distance (of) أي قريب بما يكفي للمشي. لا نقول walk distance، بل walking.
why.en: "Within walking distance" — with -ing.

blocks.example: There are three parks within walking distance of the hotel.

blocks.prompt: The city has a housing ___: there are not enough homes for the people who need them.

why.tr: "a housing shortage" = konut eksikliği. "lack" de anlamca yakın ama yapı farklı: "a lack of housing". "missing" ve "few" isim değildir.
why.ar: a housing shortage تعني نقص المساكن. وlack قريبة في المعنى لكن تركيبها مختلف: a lack of housing. أما missing وfew فليستا اسمين.
why.en: "A housing shortage"; with lack the pattern is "a lack of housing".

blocks.example: A shortage of teachers is a problem in many rural areas.

blocks.prompt: Land that was used before, for example by factories, and can be built on again is a ___ site. (one word)

why.tr: "brownfield site" = daha önce sanayi vb. için kullanılmış arazi. Zıddı "greenfield site": hiç yapı olmamış, kırsal arazi.
why.ar: brownfield site أرض استُعملت من قبل، صناعيًا غالبًا. وعكسها greenfield site أي أرض لم يُبنَ عليها.
why.en: Brownfield = used before; greenfield = never built on.

blocks.example: Building on brownfield sites protects the countryside.

blocks.prompt: Many people would leave their cars at home if ___ were cheaper and more reliable.

why.tr: "public transport" (İngiliz İngilizcesi; Amerikan: public transportation) sayılamayan bir isimdir: -s ve "a" almaz.
why.ar: public transport (وبالأمريكية public transportation) اسم غير معدود: لا يُجمع ولا يأتي مع a.
why.en: "Public transport" is uncountable: no -s, no "a".

blocks.example: Public transport in the capital runs all night.

blocks.prompt: Parks and gardens are examples of green ___ in a city. (one word)

why.tr: "green space" = yeşil alan (park, bahçe, çayır). Genel anlamda sayılamaz kullanılır ("more green space"), tek tek alanlar için "green spaces" de olur.
why.ar: green space تعني المساحات الخضراء. تُستخدم غالبًا غير معدودة (more green space)، ويُقال green spaces للأماكن المحددة.
why.en: "Green space" — usually uncountable; "green spaces" for specific places.

blocks.example: The plan will create more green space in the city centre.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: Rents have risen fast than wages.
Rents have risen faster than wages.
Rents have risen more fast than wages.
Rents have risen the fastest than wages.

why.tr: Kısa sıfat/zarflarda karşılaştırma -er ile yapılır: fast → faster than. "more fast" yanlış; "the fastest" üstünlük derecesidir ve "than" ile kullanılmaz.
why.ar: المقارنة مع الصفات والظروف القصيرة تكون بـ -er: fast ← faster than. أما more fast فخطأ، وthe fastest للتفضيل المطلق ولا تأتي مع than.
why.en: Short words compare with -er: faster than.

blocks.example: House prices have risen faster than incomes.

units.title: Media and Advertising
units.goal: Media and advertising: collocations such as target an audience, raise awareness, a reliable source, influence consumers.

blocks.text: Who Is Telling Us What?

A generation ago, most people got their news from a few newspapers and television channels. Today, news comes from countless websites and social media accounts, and anyone with a phone can publish a story. This has made information easier to find, but it has also made it harder to tell a reliable source from one that spreads false information.

Advertising has changed in the same way. Companies once paid for posters and television commercials that reached a general audience. Now they can target a particular audience, for example young parents or people interested in sport, using data about what users click on and buy. Supporters say this makes adverts more useful; critics argue that it allows companies to influence consumers in ways they do not notice, and raises serious questions about privacy.

Many countries limit advertising aimed at children, who may not understand that an advert is trying to sell them something. At the same time, the media can do a great deal of good: campaigns that raise awareness of health problems or road safety have changed public opinion on many issues. The challenge is to keep the benefits while protecting people from manipulation.
Words and collocations

items.example: Many teenagers get their news from social media.
Check the facts against a reliable source.
False information can spread very quickly online.
The television commercial was shown during the final.
The campaign targets a young audience.
Clever packaging can influence consumers.
Many users worry about their privacy online.
This programme is aimed at young children.
The campaign raised awareness of heart disease.
Public opinion has turned against the plan.
The media reported the story all day.
Some adverts use emotional manipulation.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Before you share a news story, check that it comes from a ___ source.

why.tr: "a reliable source" = güvenilir kaynak. Fiil "rely on" (güvenmek) → sıfat "reliable". "relying" ve "relied" fiil hâlleri, "reliance" isimdir.
why.ar: a reliable source تعني مصدرًا موثوقًا. الفعل rely on ← الصفة reliable. أما relying وrelied فصيغ فعلية، وreliance اسم.
why.en: rely → reliable (adjective) before the noun "source".

blocks.example: Wikipedia can be a starting point, but look for a more reliable source.

blocks.prompt: The new snack is ___ at teenagers, so the adverts appear on gaming websites. (one word)

why.tr: "be aimed at" = …e yönelik olmak. "be targeted at" da doğru. Edat her ikisinde de "at".
why.ar: be aimed at تعني موجَّه إلى، ويصح أيضًا be targeted at، وحرف الجر في الحالتين at.
why.en: "Be aimed at" (or targeted at) someone.

blocks.example: The book is aimed at beginners.

blocks.prompt: The charity started a campaign to ___ awareness of the dangers of smoking.

why.tr: Eşdizim: "raise awareness of". "raise" geçişli (nesne alır), "rise" geçişsizdir: "Prices rise" ama "They raise prices". Burada nesne (awareness) var, o yüzden raise.
why.ar: التلازم raise awareness of. الفعل raise متعدٍّ يأخذ مفعولًا، أما rise فلازم: Prices rise لكن They raise prices. هنا يوجد مفعول (awareness) فنستخدم raise.
why.en: raise (with an object) awareness; rise has no object.

blocks.example: The concert raised awareness of homelessness.

blocks.prompt: Online companies collect data about us, which worries people who care about their ___. (one word, noun from "private")

why.tr: "private" (sıfat) → "privacy" (isim): mahremiyet. "their" iyelik sıfatından sonra isim gelir.
why.ar: private (صفة) ← privacy (اسم) أي الخصوصية. بعد their يأتي اسم.
why.en: private → privacy (noun) after "their".

blocks.example: The new law is meant to protect the privacy of children online.

blocks.prompt: Advertisers use data to ___ a particular audience, such as young parents.

why.tr: "target an audience" = bir kitleyi hedeflemek; "target" doğrudan nesne alır. "aim" ise "at" ister ve genelde edilgen kullanılır: "aimed at an audience".
why.ar: target an audience تعني يستهدف جمهورًا، وtarget يأخذ مفعولًا مباشرًا. أما aim فيحتاج at: aimed at an audience.
why.en: "Target" takes a direct object; "aim" needs "at".

blocks.example: The new phone targets business users.

blocks.prompt: Public ___ has changed: most people now support the smoking ban. (one word)

why.tr: "public opinion" = kamuoyu, halkın genel görüşü. "public idea" ya da "public thought" denmez.
why.ar: public opinion تعني الرأي العام، ولا نقول public idea أو public thought.
why.en: The fixed phrase is "public opinion".

blocks.example: The minister changed his mind after public opinion turned against him.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: The media has a strong influence on young people.
The media has a strong influence to young people.
The media has a strong influence for young people.
The media has a strong influence about young people.

why.tr: Kalıp: "have an influence on someone/something". Fiil olarak ise edatsız: "The media influences young people." ("the media" hem tekil hem çoğul fiille kullanılabilir.)
why.ar: التركيب have an influence on. أما الفعل فبلا حرف جر: The media influences young people. (ويمكن أن تأخذ the media فعلًا مفردًا أو جمعًا.)
why.en: "An influence on"; as a verb, no preposition: influence someone.

blocks.example: Parents have a strong influence on their children's eating habits.

blocks.prompt: Stories that are not true and spread quickly online are a kind of ___ information. (one word)

why.tr: "false information" = yanlış bilgi. "fake news" da yaygın; akademik yazıda "false" ya da "misleading information" daha uygundur. "wrong information" de duyulur ama daha gündeliktir.
why.ar: false information تعني معلومات كاذبة. وfake news شائعة، لكن في الكتابة الأكاديمية الأفضل false أو misleading information.
why.en: "False" or "misleading" information suits academic writing best.

blocks.example: The website was closed for spreading false information.

why.ar: manipulation تعني التأثير في الناس بطريقة خفية وغير عادلة. أما awareness فهي الوعي، وcommercial إعلان.
why.en: Manipulation = influencing people in a hidden, unfair way.

blocks.example: Critics accused the company of emotional manipulation in its adverts.
